chapters.label: Live: World Cup 2024
chapters.text: The 2024 Futsal World Cup, in Uzbekistan. France play Thailand in the round of sixteen. Abdessamad Mohammed sets up Mamadou Touré, and he scores! France win five two.

chapters.label: How he dribbles
chapters.text: Mamadou plays on the wing, as an ala. This is how he dribbles: he keeps his body between the defender and the ball. Then he turns, and bursts away. Shoot!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Slow motion. Shield it with your body and your arm. Now burst past, before the defender can turn. Score!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: shield the ball with your body, then burst away!
